rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents under its Rent Control Ordinance, administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt, and owners can request other permitted exemptions.
citation_aliases: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)

unverifiable_exemptions: other exemptions under the Rent Control Ordinance require an owner exemption request

rules.key_value: Rent control for 5+ unit properties; 1-4 unit exempt
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other permitted exemptions via Rent Control Exemption Request
rules.conflict_note: The page does not state the cap formula or the effective date.

parsed.doc_summary: Jersey City Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations page. It describes Rent Control Ordinance ch. 260 and states that 1-4 unit properties are exempt. It gives no details on the other in-scope categories.
